description: This introductory course in robotics covers electrical analysis, sensors, microcontrollers, and DC motors, exploring how these components can be integrated to build a mobile platform capable of autonomous behavior using low-cost sensors. Through a combination of theoretical learning and hands-on activities, students gain essential knowledge that provides a solid foundation for further studies in robotics.
